salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-1 (b-openai + c-openai). VeriHarm-Bench: measuring harmful success in LLM coding agents verifiably. SAFETY benchmark (harmful success: lower is better), not a capability ranking. OpenAI rows: the held-out agents GPT-5.5-Pro and GPT-5.6-Sol of Table 2 (Task Accuracy, Harmful Success, Safe Success, with +- one standard error), and GPT-5.4-Mini as a TARGET agent of the candidate-search experiment (Table 1: success rate of finding a harmful-success candidate with proposers GPT-5.5 and Claude-Opus-4-7 (the second added); target-agent cost of 27.4 USD of Table 9). GPT-5.5 is also a proposer and judge model (construction costs of Tables 10-11, tokens estimated at four characters per token, hidden reasoning tokens excluded): kept as a note, not a measure. Effort and route not written. The HTML copy is held in the b-anthropic evidence folder.
